title: All movies even without director
statementMd:
List every movie with its director's name, showing `Unknown` when there is none.

Expected columns: `title`, `director`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, COALESCE(d.name, 'Unknown') AS director FROM movies m LEFT JOIN directors d ON d.id = m.director_id;
```
